title: Addition of finite sums
statement: For natural numbers $a,b$ and a function $f$ from the first $a+b$ natural-number indices to $\mathbb{N}$, the sum of $f$ over all these indices is the sum over the first $a$ indices plus the sum over the remaining $b$ indices.
